The '''Shawken system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shawken]].
